items.subject: Triage residual: Hy-Vee size-conflict bindings parked (12 pids)
evidence: hyvee-regular-2026-09-25.json capture_terms: the 12 pids (2950925, 11342, 47144, 444508, 19478, 2918306, 2925188, 1334638, 37464, 37443, 332699, 269490) each 'rejected' with 'source product size conflicts with the worklist variant'

every one of the 12 is bound by a product-urls.json Hy-Vee link (e.g. beef-stew -> /p/11342/ 'Dinty Moore Beef Stew' 38 oz; ground-cinnamon -> /p/2950925/ 2.5 oz), not by commodities.json or commodity-search.json, so it is not money-lane by the queue body's own test

comparison-2026-09-23: 9 of the 12 commodities have NO Hy-Vee cell (ground-cinnamon, beef-stew, corned-beef-hash, minced-garlic, dried-dill, ground-ginger, poblano-peppers, fresh-basil, fresh-mint); 3 are carried (sloppy-joe-sauce 09-22, cheese-tortellini 09-07, tomatillos 08-24)
resolve-hyvee-links.ps1 lines 101-136 (before this change) built its targets only from Hy-Vee cells ON the board, so the 9 were unreachable by the one tool that re-points a drifted link
items.root_cause: the drifted-link repair (resolve-hyvee-links) discovers work only from board cells, and a link whose product id Hy-Vee now answers at another size produces no fresh row, so its cell leaves the board and the repair never sees it again; the pull's refusal was recorded (the ask ledger) but read by nothing that repairs

root_fix.what: resolve-hyvee-links takes a size-conflict relink queue from the ask ledger, reaching links whose cell is off the board
root_fix.exact_change: Get-HyVeeSizeConflictRelinkTargets (pure): every product-urls.json Hy-Vee link whose /p/<id>/ is in out/hyvee-ask-ledger.json with last_outcome = the size-conflict reason, and whose link size still equals the ledger's worklist size (or the ledger size is empty for a link-only product), joins the targets with relink=true, the link's own name and size and, when one exists, the regular row of that name and size; it honours -Ids and never duplicates a board target. The existing four gates (size first, brand, negation, price or strong name) decide the match unchanged, so a link is only re-pointed to a product AT THE LINK'S SIZE. Test-HyVeeRelinkNoProgress: a best match that is the parked pid again is listed 'size conflict stands' and nothing is written. A missing or unreadable ledger adds no target.

blast_radius.measured_by: the 12 parked pids against product-urls.json and comparison-2026-09-23
blast_radius.risk: none until the first ask ledger exists (written by the 2026-09-26 08:00 pull); then at most 12 links re-pointed, each only to a product whose search size equals the link size, and a re-pointed link's price is read by the pull like any other

items.premise_verified: yes: the 12 pids refused on every run 09-23..09-25; the bindings are product-urls.json links (not a matching rule), and Hy-Vee's reported size is persisted nowhere until the ask ledger's first run records 'theirs'
items.deviation: Did not re-bind the 12 by hand: Hy-Vee's current size for each pid is recorded nowhere today (the ledger that records it has not run), and choosing a size or product by hand would be an agent-made binding. Fixed the class instead so the daily resolver re-points them by its own size-first search.
items.resolution_note: Real: 12 Hy-Vee links point at product ids Hy-Vee now answers at another size, 9 of them cells missing from the board. The drifted-link resolver could only see board cells; it now also takes every size-conflict pid from the ask ledger and re-points the link by its size-first search. Live from the first chain run after 2026-09-26 08:00; what it cannot re-point is 2026-09-25-1b7001.
